newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money stable in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money stable in liquid market.

text.p: *Central Bank offers six-mth reverse repos at 10.125 pct
Manila overnight money remained stable at an average of 9.9375 percent on Thursday on a dearth of borrowers in the market, traders said.
Rates were locked from 10.15625 to 9.9375 percent, with 32 lenders and 19 borrowers.
Market volume, however, rose to 17.258 billion from 12.053 billion pesos as more banks invested in T-bills and reverse repos, traders said.
In the secondary market, the offering of the Central Bank's six-month reverse repos dampened investor appetite for the six-month bills which had lower rates, a foreign bank dealer said.
The Central Bank's offer, however, was read by market participants that it did not want rates to move lower.
Another dealer said buying focus was more on the two-year and five-year notes which still offer attractive rates.
A Reuter poll of six financial institutions gave bid rates of 10.0 to 9.80 percent on the six-month bills.
